aimless.line: And everything with wings is restless, aimless, drunk and dour;
aimless.lineNext: The butterflies and birds collide at hot, ungodly hours
stanza: And everything with wings is restless, aimless, drunk and dour;
The butterflies and birds collide at hot, ungodly hours
And my clay-colored motherlessness rangily reclines—
Come on home, now! All my bones are dolorous with vines

stanza: The second time I went to Haida Gwaii was just me and our daughter
Only one month after you died, my face was still contorted
Driving up and down, boots wet inside, aimless and weeping
I needed to return to the place where we discovered that childless, we could bl…
But when we came home, you were pregnant
And then our life together was not long
You had cancer and you were killed and I'm left living like this
Crying on the logging roads with your ashes in a jar
Thinking about the things I'll tell you
When you get back from wherever it is that you've gone
But then I remember death is real
And I'm still here in Masset, it's August 12th, 2016
You've been dead for one month and three days, and we are sleeping in the forest
There is sand still in the blankets from the beach where we released you from t…
When we wake up, all the clothes that we left out are cold and damp just from t…
The ground opens up
Surrounded by growth
Nurse logs with layers of moss and life, young cedars, the sound of water, thic…
The ground absorbs and remakes whatever falls
Nothing dies here
But here is where I came to grieve, to dive into it with you, with your absence
But I keep picking you berries

aimless.line: I wandered so aimless, life filled with sin
aimless.lineNext: I wouldn't let my dear savior in
stanza: I wandered so aimless, life filled with sin
I wouldn't let my dear savior in
Then Jesus came like a stranger in the night
Praise the Lord, I saw the light
Then down and down
And down and down
And down and deeper
Stoke, without sound
The blameless flames
You endless sleeper

nameless.linePrev: Let the room fill with steam, traced pictures on the mirror
nameless.line: Ghosts and clouds and nameless things
nameless.lineNext: Squint your eyes and hope real hard
stanza: Ghosts and clouds and nameless things
Squint your eyes and hope real hard
Maybe sprout wings

nameless.linePrev: Nor the hand that is healing
stanza: Not what you really wanted
Nor the mess in your purse
Nor the bed that is haunted
With the blanket of thirst
It's not the hunger revealing
Nor the ricochet in the cave
Nor the hand that is healing
Nor the nameless grave

shameless.linePrev: The years ran as if for their lives
shameless.line: I, the shameless beau of a governor’s wife—
stanza: The years ran as if for their lives
I, the shameless beau of a governor’s wife—
Standing just outside of view
Holding hats and coats and shoes…
Then running guns for a lost decade
Posing as a doctor’s aide—
I pushed pins in maps to show
How to stop a plague or make it go;
And then they took me out in chains
When a secret shared had changed the game
She moved with shameless wonder
The perfect creature rarely seen
Since some liar brought the thunder
When the land was godless and free
Her eyes look sharp and steady
Into the empty parts of me
Still, my heart is heavy
With the hate of some other man's beliefs
